note: details-responsive.spec.ts (no 'lite-' prefix, so it escaped the Phase 18 inventory that scanned tests/e2e/lite-*.spec.ts) was found during this same retirement pass to be equally dead: both its tests booted through the deleted BPMN Lite 'New process' dialog into a .djs-container canvas and read a orbitpm.lite.preferences.v1.details.open localStorage key — the same removed pane lite-panes-details.spec.ts drove. It was retired for the same reason (no ARIS open/close/resize/persist mechanic exists to retarget against), which additionally emptied UI-05 and UI-06 of their sole producer. See UI-02/UI-03/UI-05/UI-06/UI-07 below for the resulting, deliberately-unbound evidence gaps.
